query: Finsupp weight with strictly positive real weights has trivial zero fiber; weight equals zero iff finitely supported natural function equals zero

items.name: Finsupp.weight_eq_zero_iff_eq_zero
items.type: {σ : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [AddCommMonoid M] [PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] [CanonicallyOrderedAdd M] (w : σ → M) [Finsupp.NonTorsionWeight ℕ w] {f : σ →₀ ℕ} : (Finsupp.weight w) f = 0 ↔ f = 0
